summary: Four supplied source profiles are missing. Fixed consistency roles expose a label shortcut; choosing the second-largest numeric option answers the exact delivered batch 5/5. Math, native grading, rendering and runtime packaging checks pass; package bytes are unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Solve for two scalar coefficients in a linear combination of two three-dimensional vectors, check all three component equations, and select the coefficient sum or No solution.
reasoning_steps: Translate vector equality into three scalar equations in x1 and x2.
Use a convenient independent pair or isolated component to determine candidate coefficients.
Check remaining component(s); a contradiction means No solution.
If consistent, compute x1+x2 and select it from the five-choice radio bank.
invariants: Two unknown scalar coefficients and two given 3-component vectors plus a target vector.
Independent coefficient columns in captured cases; unique solution or inconsistency, not general dependent infinite-solution cases.
Check consistency of all components; preserve radio selection and source bank profiles.
Worked solution must show component system, solve, check, and sum or contradiction.
permitted_variations: Change small integer vector entries and target while maintaining comparable arithmetic and independent columns.
Change coefficients, signs, zeros, coefficient sum, consistency, contradiction row, and which component gives an easy substitution.
Reassign vector naming independently of consistency: a/b versus c/d names are incidental even though source often correlates them.
Permute component rows and choice positions; retain numeric-only and mixed No solution bank profiles.
Change a target component to move a consistent instance outside the column span; change labels or row order without changing its answer.
